explanation: During the 21:10 blackout Archibald slipped off to the servants' telephone, leaving Victoria alone in the dining room. At 21:15 her husband let her into the library, and at 21:17 she killed him with the silver candlestick Reginald had just lit on his desk. She took the solicitor's letter, locked the door from outside at 21:19, burned the letter in the dining-room fire and dropped the key in the coal scuttle. The new will would have cut her to two hundred pounds a year. Her alibi was Archibald, but Reginald heard him on the telephone. Gregory, hiding in the hall, saw her lock the door, and both the key and the letter turned up in the dining room where she sat alone.
